stories.title: Why China has sent Pakistan's first astronaut into space
stories.brief: China launched its Shenzhou-24 space mission on Wednesday carrying three astronauts to its Tiangong space station, including Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first foreigner to join a Chinese crewed space mission.

stories.title: KP’s Karak reports 'first polio case in 6 years', taking countrywide 2026 tally to 10
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The National Emergency Operations Centre for Polio Eradication (NEOC) has confirmed the country’s 10th paralytic polio case of the year, with the latest infection from Karak district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The country’s ninth polio case of the year was reported earlier this month, in KP’s Khyber district.

stories.title: At least 3 killed, 14 injured after under-construction building collapses near Karachi's Baloch Colony
stories.brief: KARACHI: At least three people were killed and 14 injured on Wednesday when an under-construction building collapsed in Karachi Administration Housing Society near Baloch Colony, according to police and rescue services officials.

stories.title: Pakistan reports 8th polio case from K-P as nationwide tally reaches 10 in 2026
stories.brief: Pakistan on Wednesday reported its 10th polio case of 2026 after a 14-month-old girl from Karak district in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) tested positive for the virus, the National Emergency Operations Centre (NEOC) said.

stories.title: Dozens killed in Egypt vehicle fire
stories.brief: At least 30 have been ⁠killed and ⁠15 injured when a vehicle carrying ‌petroleum products caught fire in Egypt.

stories.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
stories.brief: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

stories.title: AJK Assembly sets conditions for resumption of dialogue with proscribed JAAC
stories.brief: It alleged that JAAC had subsequently interpreted the government’s concessions and flexibility as weakness and raised unconstitutional demands incompatible with the existing constitutional and democratic structure of AJK.

stories.title: At least 30 killed in blaze after vehicle overturns in Egypt, health ministry says
stories.brief: At least 30 people were killed and 15 ​injured when a vehicle carrying petroleum ‌products overturned and caught fire on a major ring road in Egypt, the ​health ministry said on Wednesday. The ​ring road connects key highways across ⁠Greater Cairo, linking the governorates of ​Cairo, Giza and Qalyubia.

stories.title: AJK Assembly offers conditional talks with JAAC, demands disbandment of armed groups
stories.brief: The resolution was unanimously adopted during a session chaired by AJK Legislative Assembly Speaker Chaudhry Tariq Farooq. Read: AJK orders registration of all weapon licences within 10 days The House condemned the presence of armed groups, the closure of highways, attacks on government institutions and violence against law enforcement personnel.

stories.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
stories.brief: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut welcomes baby girl from space station
stories.brief: Joshua Kutryk, currently on his first space mission, is just the fourth astronaut in history to miss the birth of a child while aboard the International Space Station.

stories.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing US trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
stories.brief: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

stories.title: Why has China sent the first Pakistani astronaut to space?
stories.brief: Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first foreign national to board China's Tiangong space station.

stories.title: The rising cost of putting food on the table in India
stories.brief: India's food inflation is broadening, squeezing household budgets.

stories.title: NCCIA claims busted call centre at Karachi's Sharea Faisal defrauding elderly US citizens
stories.brief: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) said on Wednesday that it had busted a call centre in Karachi for fraud, arresting five people and recovering Rs150 million in cash as well as about Rs60m in cryptocurrency.

stories.title: Mystery surrounds boat accident off Libyan coast as Bajaur families claim 25 deaths
stories.brief: Several families across Bajaur were left shell-shocked and plunged into mourning after reports emerged that 35 local youths had died and several others were missing following a boat accident off the Libyan coast while attempting to reach Europe through illegal routes.

stories.title: JUI alleges arrest of Maulana Ghafoor Haideri, other party leaders by Punjab Police
stories.brief: Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) spokesperson Aslam Ghauri on Wednesday alleged that party secretary-general Maulana Abdul Ghafoor Haideri had been arrested by Punjab Police, along with Punjab emir Maulana Amjad Khan and Jamiat Talaba-e-Islam (JTI) central president Malik Owais.

stories.title: India says 'cockroach' movement leader Das was told not to use passport
stories.brief: India's foreign ministry said on Wednesday that passport authorities asked 'cockroach' movement leader Saurav Das not to ​use his passport until he clarified information about ‌his place of birth.

stories.title: National conference calls for stronger safeguards for freedom of expression, journalist safety and accountability
stories.brief: The legislation drew widespread criticism from journalists, media organisations and rights activists, who argue that it undermined the fundamental right to freedom of expression.

stories.title: PM approves NCCIA restructuring, orders overhaul of cybercrime prevention system
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Wednesday ordered the modernisation of the system to prevent cybercrime in the country and approved the restructuring of the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA). A meeting, presided over by the premier, was held to review the NCCIA’s performance, administrative structure and future strategy.
